title.en: Generalisation, kernels, and mathematical learning theory
title.zh: 泛化、核方法与数学学习理论

lead.en: Prove a finite-class selection guarantee and feature-kernel validity, derive kernel ridge, and state the limits of capacity, margins and source-population evidence.
lead.zh: 证明有限类选择保证和特征核有效性，推核岭，并明确容量、间隔与源总体证据的限制。

prerequisites.en: Modules 12, 24, 26 and 27. The constrained SVM introduction is self-contained; the full duality extension requires Module 20. All labs use the pinned NumPy environment.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 12、24、26、27。SVM 约束入门自足，完整对偶拓展需模块 20。实验使用固定 NumPy 环境。

en: Define population and empirical risk with sampling and split roles stated.
Prove the finite-class uniform bound and approximate-ERM comparison.
Derive squared-loss bias–variance with its target and randomness.
Prove threshold VC dimension and distinguish capacity from target shift.
Prove feature PSD and derive mean-loss kernel ridge.
Specify margins and soft SVM conventions and qualify broader learning claims.
zh: 明确总体经验风险、抽样及拆分角色。
证有限类一致界和近似 ERM 比较。
按目标和随机性推平方损失偏差方差。
证阈值 VC 维，区分容量与目标偏移。
证特征 PSD，推均值核岭。
明确间隔与软 SVM 约定，限定更广学习声明。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive the finite-class event and ERM bound.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，推有限类事件及 ERM 界。

text.en: Retrieve loss, class and sample contracts.
text.zh: 检索损失、类及样本约定。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and distinguish fitting variability from changed populations.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，区分拟合变化与总体改变。

text.en: Measure selected optimism under an exact null score law.
text.zh: 在精确无信号分数律下测选择乐观性。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and derive PSD, ridge and margin conventions.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，推 PSD、岭和间隔约定。

text.en: Select kernel length and penalty on independent validation.
text.zh: 在独立验证选核长度和惩罚。

text.en: Diagnose indefinite similarity, shifted labels and interpolation.
text.zh: 诊断不定相似性、标签偏移及插值。

text.en: Complete choices and write a bounded-risk/kernel argument.
text.zh: 完成选择并写有界风险与核论证。

text.en: Compare capacity, kernel and duality assumptions.
text.zh: 比较容量、核与对偶条件。

text.en: Complete the exit task and qualify the learning report.
text.zh: 完成结业并限定学习报告。
